tokens.description: The keyed integer row whose cells are the tokens and whose values are the board cells they stand on; a value that is no cell is a token off the board, which the job leaves alone.

board.description: The board row over the topology the token values index; absent for a job over Zones.

zones.description: For a job over piles: the ordered zones (keysOf rows with ordered, all over the token domain Tokens names) whose ordinals are the job's cells — a token's cell is the zone it stands in, legal masks and best.to name zones, and the one shape is transfer. Exactly one of Board and Zones is authored.

turn.description: The slot row whose change marks an accepted relocation; absent, the tabletop board binding anchoring Board supplies it.

verdict.description: The slot row the rules judge a relocation into; absent, the same board binding supplies it.

shapes.description: The candidate shapes the walk enumerates, in declared order, ahead of token and target/direction; absent or empty, the one default shape (Relocate, displace: true).

items.description: One authored candidate shape a search job enumerates, ahead of token and target/direction in the walk's fixed order. Every shape but Drop requires the walked token on the board; Drop requires it off. Absent from Shapes, a job's default and only shape is Relocate with displace: true — the one candidate this section always ran.

anyOf.description: One own token moves onto any other cell of the board. Displace (default true) evicts whatever token already stood on the target — the section's original, unconditional behavior; false leaves it standing, so a judge rule that reads two tokens sharing a cell decides the candidate itself.

displace.description: Whether the token standing on the target leaves the board.

anyOf.description: A token whose current value is off the board (see Tokens's remarks) enters any cell no other token stands on.

The walked token steps two cells along one topology direction, over a token standing on the intermediate cell onto an empty destination; a direction with no such occupied intermediate, or whose destination is not empty, is not a candidate. Past MaxHops 1 (the default, this shape's original single hop, which evicts the token it steps over), one candidate chains 1..MaxHops such hops as a single move, never revisiting a cell of the chain (the token's own starting cell included) and evicting nothing along the way.

over.description: The directions tried, in the topology's own vocabulary (CompiledTopology.Direction). The single-element list ["any"] tries every direction the topology declares.

maxHops.description: How many hops one candidate may chain.

anyOf.description: The walked token relocates to the target cell and a second, fixed token — named by With, a cell key of Tokens — relocates by the same lattice translation (CompiledTopology.TryTranslation: the axial step on a grid, ring, hex, or box), provided its own destination is empty. A graph or tiling has no translations and refuses the shape. The minimal two-token primitive a castle's rook needs, not a general rule for every pair's own reach (see the schema README's search section for the reasoning).

with.description: The companion token's cell key in Tokens.

anyOf.description: The walked token relocates onto any other cell, evicting what stood there, and its own code in Codes becomes one of To — one candidate per (cell, code). The judge decides where a code may change; the shape only offers the change.

codes.description: An integer row keyed by the tokens holding each token's code.

to.description: The codes a token may take, at most MaxPromotions.

anyOf.description: The walked token — standing at the Selector end of one of the job's Zones — moves onto any other of them, landing last (the top of the pile) or, with InsertFirst, first: the transfer transform as a candidate, so pile order is what the zones already hold. A token anywhere but the selected end, or a full destination, is not a candidate. The only shape a zone job enumerates, and refused by a board job.

selector.description: Which end of its zone a token must stand at to move: Last (default, the top of the pile) or First.

insertFirst.description: Whether the token lands first in the destination rather than last.

legal.description: An integer row keyed by the tokens receiving, per token, the mask of cells it may relocate to; requires a board of at most 64 cells.

reach.description: An integer board row over the same topology as Board receiving, at 1, the cells Held's named token may reach and, at its own empty value, every other cell; unlike Legal, works for a board of any size. Authored together with Held.

held.description: An integer slot row naming the token whose accepted destinations are painted into Reach — its own ordinal in Tokens's cell order. A value out of range paints nothing.

counts.description: An integer row keyed by the tokens receiving, per token, how many candidates it accepted; unlike Legal, works for a board of any size.

nodes.description: The relocations judged per tick, at most what the work sheet leaves; absent derives that.

depth.description: How many plies the job searches ahead; the depth-one walk this section always ran. A depth past one asks what the position is worth after the ply, not merely whether it is legal, and requires Score.

score.description: An infix expression, in the rule expression grammar, evaluated over the frame after a ply from the perspective of the side that made it; iterative-deepening negamax with alpha-beta compares it across plies — the two-sided, zero-sum reading of what a ply is worth. Exactly one of this and Scores is authored when a score is needed; required when Depth exceeds one, or Best is authored, and refused with Tree unauthored alongside it.

best.description: A keyed integer row receiving the deepest completed depth's answer: token (the mover's ordinal in Tokens), to (its destination cell), and score (the negamax value, or, with Scores authored, the root mover's own seat's value).

method.description: How plies are compared by the score: Negamax to the depth cap, or Tree, which reads the score where no candidate is accepted or at the cap.

iterations.description: How many tree iterations a Tree job runs before it lands.

chance.description: The job's chance node, or null for a job with none.

row.description: The keyed integer row a chosen outcome writes.

atDepth.description: Negamax: the absolute ply (0 = root) whose move choice is replaced, 0..depth-1. Tree: the 1-based playout ply the chance draw replaces.

scores.description: A keyed integer row, one cell per seat in Turn's own ordinal order, holding each seat's own current score — the n-seat reading of what a ply is worth: a level maximizes the mover seat's own entry rather than negating the reply, so no seat's gain is assumed to be another's loss (max-n). Exactly one of this and Score is authored when a score is needed; refused with Tree, whose outcome backprop alternates sign along the path.
